SOPHIE.conditional: included iff s1d served anonymously and header UT inside the 2.5 Rsun window

statistics.S_line: max over in-window spectra of max_cell matched-filter S; T = max over null ensemble
statistics.S_coadd: max_cell S on the mean of n in-window spectra; T = max over 60 draws of n nulls; units with n >= 2

power: P = 1.0645 * A90 * Flambda_cont * FWHM_lambda * pi * b_rung^2
photometry_source: Gaia DR3 G/BP/RP + 2MASS J/H/Ks via SIMBAD (snapshotted), log-log interpolated

amendments_v1_1.A1_wavelength_solution_gate: stellar-region cross-correlation shift vs the ensemble template <= 3 px, nulls and in-window alike (found: one CARMENES ross-154 frame with a wrong header BERV, car-20170911)
amendments_v1_1.A2_pixel_snr_gate: the frozen SNR >= 5 gate applied at spectrum and pixel granularity: (i) a spectrum whose median raw flux/error over the band is < 5 is unusable (found: HARPS 118-s frame with SNR 0.95); (ii) per spectrum, pixels whose local running-median continuum has cont/running-median(err) < 5 are masked (found: zero-flux blue orders of the M dwarfs, CARMENES 520-540 nm, HARPS < 410 nm, normalised to +-1e3); (iii) pixels with ensemble-median photon SNR < 5 excluded from every cell
amendments_v1_1.A3_psf_consistent_statistic: S_line / S_coadd = max over local maxima of S (floor 4, distance 3 px, <= 200 peaks fitted) whose Gaussian fit to z has FWHM within [0.6, 2.0] x instrumental and |mu - peak| <= 2 px; despike of isolated single-pixel spikes (|z|>4, neighbours < 0.4|z|) retained; identical for nulls, coadd draws and in-window spectra (found: 1-3 px cosmic hits and normalisation blow-ups adjacent to masked runs set T at 1e3-1e5 in every dev combo)
amendments_v1_1.A4_loaders: X-shooter IDP WAVE unit read from TUNIT (nm); SPIRou Recon/OHLine extensions optional; HARPS s1d has no error vector -> photon-shaped error scaled to the header SNR
amendments_v1_1.A5_berv_check: D8 BERV-sign check evaluated on stellar-line regions (none/applied/flipped cross-correlation), not whole-band RMS
amendments_v1_1.A6_sigma_floor: per-pixel scale sigma_i = max(ensemble MAD scatter, the spectrum's OWN propagated photon error) (the frozen wording); the first implementation floored on the ensemble-median error, over-weighting low-SNR spectra (robust z scale up to 3.4, corr(scale, SNR) = -0.9)
amendments_v1_1.A7_bookkeeping: expected exceedances per unit = sum over S_line cells of n/(N+n) (max over n in-window spectra vs max over N nulls) + coadd cells/(n_draws+1); the frozen 1/(N+1) holds only for n = 1
amendments_v1_1.A8_xshooter: X-shooter arms excluded from the family (dev: 4 phase-3 product variants per exposure violate the unit definition, no BERV keyword, single-night null pool blind to night-to-night sky residuals, 14/36 in-window products fail the wavelength gate); no confirmatory X-shooter unit exists
amendments_v1_1.A9_espresso_frame: ESPRESSO phase-3 WAVE is vacuum (a WAVE_AIR column exists; K I 7699 / Na D land at vacuum positions); the v1.0 flag (air, as HARPS) double-converted the grid by +84 km/s. Found in confirmatory adjudication via the Hg-lamp pentad in the ross-128 2020-03-16 spectrum; the two ESPRESSO combos were re-run with the corrected frame (first-pass ESPRESSO results kept in results/confirmatory_search_v1_espresso_airflag.json). The statistic is translation-invariant; only the stellar-line masks and cell edges move.

load_flags_seen_at_dev.stellar_mask: the frozen +-150 km/s stellar-line list is masked out of every cell for nulls and in-window spectra (declared: lines coincident with stellar emission lines are unconstrained)
